bullets.text: Velachery and Kolathur reported road cave-ins due to damaged underground water pipelines and metro rail tunneling, requiring immediate repair and safety monitoring by local authorities.
Cyclone Murasu triggered high sea surges and heavy rainfall in Chennai and Thiruvallur, leading police to issue high-level alerts and school closures for safety.
Tiruvallur Collector S. Kavitha declared a school holiday for Monday due to heavy rainfall forecasts from Cyclone Murasu, and the office should monitor disaster response operations.
Pelican birds resting on high-voltage transmission towers in the Pallikaranai marshland are frequently electrocuted, and the office should coordinate with electricity boards to insulate power lines.
The Traders Federation Youth Wing organized an anti-drug marathon in Besant Nagar to raise public awareness, and the office should support similar youth engagement initiatives.

The 22-kilometer Padi-Thiruninravur stretch of the Chennai-Tiruvallur Highway faces severe traffic congestion because the six-lane widening proposal remains delayed, requiring the office to push for project acceleration.
CMRL reduced travel time on the Poonamallee-Vadapalani corridor to thirty minutes, improving commuter connectivity across the region.
Residents in Ayanambakkam opposed the laying of drainage pipes from apartment complexes violating norms in Thirverkadu municipality, and the office should review the municipal drainage approvals.
L&T's Vyoma.AI started construction on a 52 MW AI data centre in Chennai, cementing the city's position as a growing digital hub that the office should actively support.
MeitY launched the DEPA handbook to support safe data sharing for AI training, and the state IT department should review its protocols to align with these new guidelines.
Rising demand for artificial intelligence is driving Indian data centre capacity expansion toward 2 GW in 2026, presenting clear investment opportunities for Tamil Nadu.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 will bring founders and investors together at the Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway on November 14, and the digital services team should participate.
